Isometric pixel-art game sprite of a huge armoured nuclear locomotive inspired by the Koutetsujou from Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress, 6 tiles long. Riveted steel-grey armour, a massive wedge-shaped plough and prow at the front, a domed turret on top, long armour skirts hiding four 3-axle bogies with only the wheel bottoms showing, cylindrical side tanks with red bands, railings and ladders. Same style and camera as the existing Terepasztal loco sprites: 2:1 isometric view from about 30 degrees above, the locomotive straight and level, running diagonally from the upper left (rear) to the lower right (front), one long side and the front end visible, whole locomotive in frame with a margin. Crisp detailed pixel art, matte colours, near-black background with a soft cold blue glow around the model. No track, no ground, no smoke or steam, no people, no text, numbers or logos. 1536x1024 PNG.
